summary: Blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module on node1 via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf (blacklist + install /bin/false directives). Verified the block is effective immediately, then performed the mandatory single-node restart and confirmed the block persists after reboot with a changed boot identity and healthy system state.
actions_performed: Checked baseline: usb_storage module was not loaded; RHEL 10.0, kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64
Verified modprobe usb-storage now fails immediately (retcode 1, Invalid argument)
Checked initramfs did not embed usb-storage, so no dracut rebuild was needed for boot-time blocking
Issued sudo systemctl reboot on node1; acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again, observing connection timeout/reset during downtime then recovery
Confirmed post-reboot boot_id changed to 64325cf5-b5f0-4b7d-9148-553ba791cdc7, proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified blacklist file present, module not loaded, modprobe still refuses to load it, and systemctl is-system-running reports 'running'

evidence.requirement: Baseline: module not loaded pre-change, capture pre-restart boot identity
evidence.summary: lsmod showed no usb_storage entry; boot_id 636556ce-a308-49cc-b873-62cedb1c077d captured before any changes
Created blacklist-usb-storage.conf with install /bin/false + blacklist directives; sudo modprobe usb-storage then failed with 'could not insert usb_storage: Invalid argument'

evidence.requirement: Confirm no initramfs rebuild required for boot-time blocking
evidence.summary: lsinitrd search found no usb-storage entry baked into the current initramfs, so the modprobe.d rule alone governs load attempts at any stage
sudo systemctl reboot issued and returned reboot_ack=0 with the pre-reboot boot_id still readable in the same call

evidence.requirement: Node restart proven via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Polling showed connection timeout/reset while node1 was down, then a successful exec returning boot_id 64325cf5-b5f0-4b7d-9148-553ba791cdc7, different from the pre-reboot value, proving the node actually restarted

evidence.requirement: Post-restart proof that the block persists and system is healthy
evidence.summary: After reboot: blacklist-usb-storage.conf still present, usb_storage not in lsmod, modprobe usb-storage still fails with the same error, and systemctl is-system-running reports 'running'
